task: Turn an instrumental recording into editable MIDI notes

x-display.title: Turn an instrument recording into MIDI
x-display.summary: Convert pitched notes in an instrument recording into an editable MIDI file.
x-display.description: Bring a recorded melody into a music editor to adjust notes or try another instrument sound. MIDI describes the notes rather than storing the original audio, so the result is a starting point for arranging and editing.

packaging_note: Runs the bundled Basic Pitch model on CPU. The sample is a generated three-note melody.

inputs.what: an instrumental recording with clearly pitched notes

outputs.what: a MIDI file you can open in a music editor

known_issues: Best with a single instrument. Speech, percussion and dense full-band mixes are not suitable.
